topic: North Field West (NFW) EPCC contract award
wiki_text: On 25 February 2026, QatarEnergy awarded the engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning (EPCC) contract for the onshore facilities of the North Field West (NFW) expansion to a joint venture led by Technip Energies with Consolidated Contractors Company (CCC) and Gulf Asia Contracting (GAC). The contract covers two 8 MTPA liquefaction trains (16 MTPA total) plus carbon capture (~1.1 MTPA CO2), replicating the North Field South train design. NFW is the third and final North Field expansion phase and is expected to lift Qatar's total LNG export capacity to 142 MTPA. First cargo, originally targeted for 2030 at the project's 2024 announcement, is now expected by the end of 2031.

topic: 2026 Iran conflict impact on North Field Expansion
wiki_text: In late February and March 2026, Iranian strikes targeted Qatar's Ras Laffan industrial complex. QatarEnergy suspended construction work on the North Field Expansion and evacuated non-essential offshore personnel, and on/around 24 March 2026 declared force majeure on some LNG supply contracts after halting liquefaction operations. The Energy Minister stated a strike on 18 March 2026 disrupted roughly 17% of Qatar's LNG export capacity, with damage estimated to take 3-5 years to repair. Reporting indicated full North Field East (NFE) construction resumed in May 2026 following an April 2026 ceasefire. The disruption introduced uncertainty into the NFE first-train startup, which had been targeted for mid-2026; anonymous-sourced reporting suggested a possible slip to early 2027, though QatarEnergy had not officially confirmed a revised date as of this batch.
